series.title: Attention
series.summary: Protecting focus in an interrupt-heavy life.

articles.title: Cut inputs on purpose
articles.body:
Attention is recovered by reducing inputs, not by wishing for discipline.

Batch messages and give deep work a closed door — even a metaphorical one.

articles.title: Recovery is part of the work
articles.body: Sleep and walks are not optional DLC. Without recovery, focus blocks become theater.

series.title: Growth loops
series.summary: Feedback and review as a loop, not a mood.

articles.title: Action → review → adjust
articles.body:
Improvement is a loop: act, review with evidence, adjust one variable.

Skipping review turns motion into busyness.
